title: Confined accelerated-Collatz words — companion computations
description:
Exact-arithmetic computations, pre-registrations and reports supporting the confined accelerated-Collatz word studies: the reduction of the checkpoint decision tree to a staircase-constrained lattice-path count, slope-independence of the global shape of the weighted profile, and two closed proof routes for the uniqueness of its maximum.

Every confinement, prune, return and tie decision is an exact integer comparison. Each study froze its predictions in a pre-registration committed before the held-out computation, and the reports state where those frozen predictions failed as well as where they held.

No claim here bears on the Collatz conjecture or on any O(log m) occupation bound.
